t.t-value: 'sc-pill-%s-%s-%s%s' % (sc_pill_target['model'].replace('.', '-'), sc_pill_target['id'], pill['key'], ('-%s' % scope) if scope else '')

button.t-att-data-sc-pill-post: None if option['disabled'] else option.get('post', option['value'])

div.t-if: add_label or sorts or count or header_fragment

t.t-value: ([s for s in sorts if s['active']] or sorts)[0]

dialog.t-att-data-sc-lazy-fresh: '1' if lazy_url and lazy_fresh else None

nav.t-attf-class: o_sc_segmented o_sc_segmented_full o_sc_page_tabs #{'o_sc_page_tabs_scroll' if len(tabs) > 5 else ''}

a.t-att-data-sc-tab-aliases: tab[3] if len(tab) > 3 and tab[3] else None

span.t-if: title_parts and any(part.get('url') for part in title_parts)

a.t-attf-class: o_sc_chip o_sc_activity_clock o_sc_chip_#{'red' if clock.get('overdue') else 'ghost'}

t.t-value: 'overdue' if activity.date_deadline < today_date else ('today' if activity.date_deadline == today_date else 'planned')
'red' if act_state == 'overdue' else ('yellow' if act_state == 'today' else 'green')

button.t-att-aria-label: ('%s · EpiPen' % pill['text']) if pill['epipen'] else pill['text']

li.t-attf-class: o_sc_card o_sc_med_card o_sc_med_item #{'o_sc_edit_card' if editable else ''}
